comment: Source of truth for OpenCode permission payload shapes. Tests drive every entry through the autopilot and assert `expect`; README's payload-shape table is generated from this file. When a future core drifts again, add/adjust an entry here first.

shapes.name: core-flat-directory
shapes.docs: current cores: properties ARE the Permission info and `permission` holds the tool-name string

shapes.name: core-flat-directory-sensitive
shapes.docs: same flat shape, but the requested boundary hits the cross-OS sensitive denylist

shapes.name: core-flat-bash
shapes.docs: shell asks under the flat shape are approved unless the danger blocklist matches

shapes.name: legacy-type-field
shapes.docs: older cores / mocks named the field `type` instead of `permission`

shapes.name: nested-info-object
shapes.docs: some intermediate builds wrapped the info object under p.permission on permission.asked

shapes.name: unknown-type-safe-mode
shapes.docs: unlisted tools stay human-decided in safe mode
